env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.reason: OpenAI provider authentication; set this or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. OpenAI is preferred when both are set.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.reason: Anthropic provider authentication when OPENAI_API_KEY is absent; one provider key is required.

env.name: RELAI_DEMO_CHALLENGE
env.reason: Existing optional demo tool challenge selection; leave empty for normal smoke.

env.name: AIRLINE_MODEL_PROVIDER
env.reason: Set relai in playground sessions to use the scoped model gateway and backend-selected profile.

env.name: RELAI_API_BASE
env.reason: Session-specific playground runtime gateway base URL.

env.name: RELAI_TEAM_API_KEY
env.reason: Temporary session-scoped gateway token; never a shared provider key.
